title: gapbench: Leakage-safe benchmarking of gap handling for annual heat extremes and river-temperature trends
description: gapbench is an MIT-licensed, NumPy-only Python package for leakage-safe benchmarking of gap handling in annual heat-extreme and river-temperature records. Version 1.3.0 provides observed-window bounds, finite-record slopes, calendar-only year selection, slope-error decomposition, group-disjoint splits, archive masking, date-aware annual H30 with observed lower bounds, a reproducible controlled-gap generator, dependency-free reconstruction baselines (climatology, interpolation, pathwise AR(1) bridges) and a benchmark runner for user-supplied reconstructors, with an associated EMS case study. This deposit is software only: it does not redistribute observational data or establish reservoir causation.
notes: Version 1.3.0 is marked by GitHub release v1.3.0. No archival DOI has been minted yet; the historical v1.0.0 tag is not this version. Do not treat any DOI as the current release until a Zenodo deposit is recorded. No observational data are licensed by this record; restricted observations are excluded.
